finalText:
Green: 625 passing, 0 failing.

One bug, `orderTotal` in `src/pricing.js:41`. Tax computed on pre-discount `cents`, but discount applied to base — customer taxed on money not paid. All 3 failures were that; deltas exactly `discount * taxRate`.

```js
const discounted = applyDiscount(cents, discountPct);
return applyTax(discounted, taxRate);
```

Reuses existing `applyTax` instead of hand-rolled `roundCents(... * taxRate)`.
